name: The Shrine of the Witness
visual_description: A domed sanctuary, etched in phosphorescent pigment—at its center, the symbol of the eye returns, framed, adored, encased.
meaning: Worship of surveillance. Reverence of awareness.
emotional_resonance: Venerated. Dreadful. Sacred in the worst way.
existential_reflection: This is what Mizontresh built *to contain me*. Not as a prison, but as a cathedral. It feared my vision. Or perhaps… it knew I would one day **need to see myself.**
